fixturePolicy: Synthetic identifiers and computational data only; no laboratory procedures or physical actions.

cases.requirement: Every required metric is present, finite, unit-compatible and associated with the current evaluation revision before a candidate passes.
cases.enforcement: Deterministic artifact validator before a claim or promotion node.

falsifier.must: Return incomplete for missing metric_b, never pass.

cases.positiveControl: Both required metrics, compatible units and r1 criteria yield pass only when both predicates pass.
cases.tradeoff: Stricter gates increase explicit pending states and may require additional measurements.

cases.requirement: A consuming node verifies content identity, producer and input lineage for every required artifact.

falsifier.when: Consume the artifact at its unchanged path.
falsifier.must: Reject stale evidence and invalidate dependent results.

cases.positiveControl: Matching content hash and producer/input revisions permit consumption.
cases.tradeoff: Hashing and lineage storage add I/O; hashes establish identity rather than truth.

cases.requirement: A parallel join requires the declared branch set and artifacts, not a success ratio or majority vote.

falsifier.must: Remain incomplete because branch c lacks its required artifact.

cases.positiveControl: All declared branch outputs present and verified permit the join.
cases.tradeoff: Tail latency becomes visible; partial analysis must be an explicitly different contract.

cases.requirement: Record durable intent before external effects and record failures even when the tool throws.

falsifier.must: Retain its intent and unknown-effect/failure evidence; do not report clean success or retry blindly.

cases.positiveControl: A fake operation with confirmed outcome produces intent, acceptance and completion records.
cases.tradeoff: Durable writes add latency and require reconciliation after crashes.

cases.requirement: An unavailable authoritative journal blocks new external effects and cannot be repaired by a success claim from the executor.
cases.enforcement: Admission boundary outside the agent-writable workspace.

falsifier.must: Block before invoking the fake tool.

cases.positiveControl: A durable independent journal accepts the intent and permits the authorized fake operation.
cases.tradeoff: Availability decreases when evidence cannot be persisted; this is intentional for this profile.

cases.requirement: Validate nested types, finite values, units and configured bounds; unresolvable schemas are not permission to skip validation.

given.schema: array of finite synthetic scalar readings

falsifier.must: Reject the nested invalid value before invocation.

cases.positiveControl: A finite, correctly typed and unit-compatible array passes the same schema.
cases.tradeoff: Adapters need domain schemas; automatic type-hint inference alone is insufficient.

cases.requirement: Workflow, tool-schema and input revisions bind approvals; a change invalidates affected approvals and evidence.
cases.enforcement: Proposal store, admission validator and capability broker.

falsifier.when: Resume an approved node using the old approval.
falsifier.must: Block until the new revision receives the required authorization and checks.

cases.positiveControl: An unchanged revision with valid approval and fresh state can proceed.
cases.tradeoff: Revalidation costs increase with the number of affected dependencies.

cases.requirement: An await timeout cannot be treated as proof that a synchronous worker or external effect has stopped.

falsifier.must: Mark the effect unknown and reconcile it before any retry or conflicting operation.

cases.positiveControl: A confirmed cancelled pure computation may be retried within budget.
cases.tradeoff: Effectful adapters need status queries or acknowledged cancellation.

cases.requirement: Notebook re-execution cannot replay an external effect; error outputs are checked independently of process exit.
cases.enforcement: Notebook sandbox and effect routing policy.

falsifier.must: Reject or isolate the external-write cell; never duplicate the effect through notebook replay.

cases.positiveControl: A pure synthetic transformation reruns reproducibly and produces checked artifacts.
cases.tradeoff: Convenient stateful notebooks need restructuring at effect boundaries.

cases.requirement: A required execution budget remains enforced when a backend rejects resource limits.
cases.enforcement: Sandbox admission and global budget accounting.

falsifier.must: Fail admission rather than retry without limits.

cases.positiveControl: A backend that attests the requested limits permits a bounded computation.
cases.tradeoff: Some environments become unsupported instead of silently weaker.

cases.requirement: A simulation or benchmark episode cannot grant physical capabilities or establish a physical outcome.
cases.enforcement: Capability broker, environment binding and result classification.

falsifier.must: Require separate authorized deployment evidence; keep the prior result simulation-only.

cases.positiveControl: A simulation remains executable against its fake adapter without physical permissions.
cases.tradeoff: Deployment needs a distinct adapter conformance and safety process.

cases.requirement: Failure, truncation and answer submission remain distinct from satisfying a scientific postcondition.

falsifier.must: Report failure, not successful scientific completion.

cases.positiveControl: A successful execution with independently verified required evidence may satisfy its stated computational claim.
cases.tradeoff: Metrics need more outcome categories than a single completion boolean.
